scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach((file)=>{try{fs.rmSync(file,{force:true});}catch{}}); const userAgent=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if(!userAgent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./Frontend" --filter "./Backend" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
